answer_sql:
SELECT
  brand
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
GROUP BY
  p.brand
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.sale_country_code) = (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT country_code)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_country
    WHERE
      is_placeholder = FALSE
  )
ORDER BY
  brand

turns.did:
WITH total_countries AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM contoso_served.dim_country
  WHERE
    is_placeholder = FALSE
), brand_countries AS (
  SELECT
    p.brand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.sale_country_code) AS country_count
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
    ON s.product_key = p.product_key
  GROUP BY
    p.brand
)
SELECT
  bc.brand
FROM brand_countries AS bc
CROSS JOIN total_countries AS tc
WHERE
  bc.country_count = tc.cnt
ORDER BY
  bc.brand
